messages:
maria: Heads-up — we're gating model-routing v2.4.1 behind a feature flag for tonight's midnight deploy. Planning a slow ramp: 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~3 hours. Can everyone ack and confirm rollback thresholds?

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled at 2026-03-22T00:00Z for service=model-router tag=v2.4.1. Will post status updates.

aj: ack. propose telemetry gates: p95 latency + request error rate + generation-quality-regression on eval set. Suggest stop and rollback if p95 increases >20ms or error_rate >0.5%.

sophie: agree. Add a small "golden prompts" prompt-fidelity check. If hallucination or fidelity drop >3% we stop the ramp and investigate.

jamal: For rollback, prefer pinning to v2.4.0 instead of a full feature disable — faster and preserves traffic routing. Pin command we use: `ff pin model-routing --version=v2.4.0 --cohort=all`. Also preparing a hotpatch script in case we need forced evict of kv-cache.

maria: perfect. Release notes posted: https://confluence.redwood/team/releases/v2.4.1 — includes canary prompts, telemetry dashboards, and fail criteria. Plan: 1% at +10m, 5% at +30m, 20% at +90m, then 100% if clean.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started — cohort beta1 -> 1% (nodes: pool-ded-03). Will report health at +10m.

sophie: quick checklist for nights: token-cost-per-request, kv-cache-hit-rate, memory-gpu pressure, and trace spikes for slow-attention kernels. Set alert if kv-cache-hit drops >15%.

aj: I'll wire dashboard alerts and add A/B labels to logs so we can diff traces quickly. Also capturing a small sample of generations for the eval harness.

maria: rollback playbook in thread: if any gate trips, perform `ff set model-routing --enabled=false` then pin to v2.4.0 if needed. Tagging oncall: @jamal @aj @sophie :eyes:

devops-bot: Note: Feature flag changes are rate-limited by service quotas. Recommend using `ff ramp` with explicit steps rather than manual toggles. Example: 

```
ff ramp --flag model-routing --path=canary --steps "1@10m,5@20m,20@1h,100@2h" --dry-run=false
```

This will also emit audit events to /audit/feature-flags.

jamal: OK standing by for the first gate. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary health at +10m: p95 +5ms, error_rate 0.04% (below thresholds). Advancing to 5%. Next report in +20m.

maria: moving to 5%. Keep the golden prompt checks running and call an immediate rollback if any gate trips or noise increases. Thanks everyone.
